Spec: rewrite BEH-EA-055 as 'secure default + typed opt-in modes', add a BEH id per mode, update traceability; document the embedded mode's trade-offs (SameSite=None relies on CSRF token).

A SecureDomain mode issues __Secure-session with Domain; __Host- + Domain is a type error.

decision_options: A) Keep BEH-EA-055 fixed (status quo): wontfix IC-007/EP-008/AGA-004; fix BO-005 only by adding a lifetime to the fixed set.

C) Free-form cookie options passthrough (Auth.js style).

SameSite=None modes must keep the CSRF double-submit middleware mandatory (document in BEH-EA-055/Csrf).
issues.notes: Fact holds exactly: one compile-time constant, no escape hatch. It is spec-mandated (BEH-EA-055), so relaxing it is a product decision.
